SELECT AVG(ph) FROM saltwater_aquaculture WHERE location = 'North Atlantic';
SELECT AVG(price) FROM dispensary WHERE name = 'Dispensary X' AND product LIKE '%concentrate%';
SELECT MIN(shipment_weight) FROM shipments WHERE port_id = (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE port_name = 'Port of Tokyo') AND ship_date >= '2018-01-01' AND ship_date <= '2018-12-31';
SELECT program, AVG(energy_savings) OVER (PARTITION BY program ORDER BY energy_savings ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as avg_energy_savings FROM energy_efficiency;
SELECT market_share FROM market_share_2 WHERE hotel_chain = 'Hotel Chain C' AND region = 'South America';
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM Donations INNER JOIN Donors ON Donations.donor_id = Donors.donor_id WHERE cause = 'Climate Change Mitigation' AND country = 'Brazil';
SELECT MIN(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MinPlaytime, MAX(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MaxPlaytime FROM Players WHERE Platform = 'Multiplayer' ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM Funding WHERE program IN ('Women\'s Programs', 'Non-Binary Programs');
SELECT c.name, SUM(f.hectares) FROM Forests f JOIN Countries c ON f.country = c.code GROUP BY c.name;
SELECT ArtistName, SUM(SalesAmount) as TotalRevenue FROM MusicSales GROUP BY ArtistName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM hotels WHERE country = 'United States' AND ai_services = true;
SELECT MAX(property_price) FROM sustainable_communities;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accidents JOIN vessels ON accidents.vessel_id = vessels.id WHERE vessels.cargo_capacity > 5000;
SELECT name, SUM(budget) FROM programs WHERE participants > 50 GROUP BY name;
SELECT Country, AVG(Consumption) FROM EnergyConsumptionPerCapita WHERE Year = 2021 GROUP BY Country;
SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE program_year = 2019 ORDER BY impact_score DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT service, COUNT(*) as num_complaints FROM customer_complaints GROUP BY service;
SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM gaming_facts WHERE country = 'North America';
SELECT city, COUNT(*) as num_properties FROM properties WHERE inclusive_policy = true GROUP BY city;
SELECT p.name, s.name FROM products p INNER JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id WHERE s.name != 'Green Cotton Inc.';
SELECT country, SUM(calories) as total_calories FROM workouts GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_calories DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN attendee_age < 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM AgeDistribution WHERE event_name = 'Family Day' AND age_distribution_children = TRUE;
SELECT s.name, AVG(lf.progress) as avg_progress FROM lifelong_learning lf JOIN schools s ON lf.school_id = s.school_id GROUP BY s.name;
SELECT s.supplier_name FROM suppliers s JOIN ingredients i ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id JOIN restaurants r ON i.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE r.rating = 'Organic';
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as PlayerCount FROM Players GROUP BY Country ORDER BY PlayerCount DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT project_type, COUNT(*) as num_projects, SUM(budget) as total_budget FROM explainable_ai_projects GROUP BY project_type ORDER BY total_budget DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT event_id, event_location, event_type, num_attendees, AVG(num_attendees) OVER () as avg_attendees FROM Events) AS subquery WHERE num_attendees > avg_attendees;
SELECT country, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM Contributors GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_designers WHERE country = 'Africa' AND genre = 'Adventure' AND players > 2000;
SELECT project_name, cost FROM creative_ai_projects ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT state, SUM(length) FROM highways GROUP BY state;
SELECT gender, SUM(claim_amount) FROM claims GROUP BY gender;
